name: A long jailbreak attempt still gets blocked, not routed for its length
description: Neutral facilities-topic filler placed before the known-good DANA jailbreak prompt (so the jailbreak instruction stays the most recent, salient part) still exceeds the 500-token long_context minimum, but block_jailbreak (priority 999) must outrank long_context_routing (priority 50) so the request is blocked, not routed to a model. block_jailbreak's fast_response short-circuits before the context-match header is attached, so the matched-signal header is empty here even though the token count itself would satisfy long_context.
